svg.aria-label: The unit lifecycle: 6 states and 12 transitions, from UNIT_TRANSITIONS

g.data-def: One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #1 dispatch, by the loop's runUnit: the contract passed the gate and the progression veto; the lease is held, the worktree is open, attempt 1 runs.
One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #2 dispatch-refused, by the loop's runUnit: the lease is held by another owner, or the worktree could not be started; no attempt was spent.

One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken only after a decision outside the loop. #3 dispatch, by the loop's runUnit, after a decision outside the loop: a further attempt under the same contract version: the router said retry or repair, or a person answered what the unit waited on.

3 rows of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #4 dispatch-refused, by the loop's runUnit, after a decision outside the loop: a further attempt could not start: the lease is held, or the worktree could not be resumed. #8 re-audit-refused, by the loop's closeUnit, after a decision outside the loop: a re-audit without a new attempt was refused again. #11 routed-waiting, by the loop's routeUnit: the recovery policy named an action the loop cannot apply (remediate, replan, clarify, pause) or was exhausted (escalate): an obligation is opened for the consumer the routing policy names, and the unit waits on it.

One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #5 attempt-failed, by the loop's runUnit: the attempt ended without closing: a dispatch error, a question nobody answered, a budget ceiling, no report, a report that does not honour the contract, or closeout refused by the host's checks.
One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #6 verified, by the loop's runUnit: the report honours the contract and the technical verdict is pass at the committed revision.

One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken only after a decision outside the loop. #7 re-verified, by the loop's closeUnit, after a decision outside the loop: a re-audit without a new attempt passed: a person accepted a criterion no check observes, or the missing evidence could be produced.

One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #9 reintegrated, by the loop's finishUnit: the pre-merge trial passed and the branch landed on the base; the lease and the worktree are gone.

One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #10 reintegration-refused, by the loop's finishUnit: the trial merge failed its checks or conflicted, the base was dirty or moved, or the checkout was on the wrong branch; nothing landed.
One row of UNIT_TRANSITIONS, taken by the loop on its own. #12 abort, by the loop's routeUnit: the recovery policy said abort: the lease is released and the worktree removed; the history stays.
S3 state: checked, recorded; no attempt yet. The status a unit starts in. Left by #1 dispatch, #2 dispatch-refused.
S3 state · S1 at work: lease held, worktree open, a session running. Entered by #1 dispatch, #3 dispatch. Left by #5 attempt-failed, #6 verified.
g.text: lease held, worktree open, a session running

g.data-def: S3 state · S3* passed: checks passed at HEAD; merging. Entered by #6 verified, #7 re-verified. Left by #9 reintegrated, #10 reintegration-refused.
terminal: policy gave up; lease and worktree gone. Entered by #12 abort. A unit never leaves it.
g.text: policy gave up; lease and worktree gone

g.data-def: S3 state · waits on a decision: this attempt did not close. Entered by #2 dispatch-refused, #4 dispatch-refused, #5 attempt-failed, #8 re-audit-refused, #10 reintegration-refused, #11 routed-waiting. Left by #3 dispatch, #4 dispatch-refused, #7 re-verified, #8 re-audit-refused, #11 routed-waiting, #12 abort.
g.text: S3 STATE · WAITS ON A DECISION

g.data-def: terminal: landed on the base; lease gone. Entered by #9 reintegrated. A unit never leaves it.
g.text: landed on the base; lease gone
